This spike is primarily caused by tensions between Washington and Iran, which have disrupted global fuel supplies. As a result, transportation costs for essential goods are on the rise, impacting consumers with higher fees on online purchases. Additionally, the conflict has driven crude oil prices over one hundred dollars a barrel.

Recent adjustments to the IPO size indicate a reduction of over fifteen percent, coinciding with major offerings from Reliance Jio and Hyundai Motor India.

title: US consumer inflation picks up in August, up 3.4% YoY
description: In August, consumer prices in the U.S. surged, mainly due to increasing gasoline prices. This trend elevates the likelihood of an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve, with economists predicting a monthly rise in the consumer price index of 0.4%. When excluding food and energy, the core consumer price index saw a 0.3% rise, leading to a market expectation of a 70% chance for a 25-basis-point hike.

title: Sebi imposes Rs 2 lakh penalty on Emami Realty for regulatory lapses
